children: Appetite for risk assets improves as oil prices fall following media reports about oil shipments moving through the Strait of Hormuz. The U.S.-China trade talks have also contributed to the positive mood, Tickmill Group's Patrick Munnelly says in a note. For now, markets appear to look beyond the geopolitical tensions in the Middle East and European political uncertainty, he says. (miriam.mukuru@wsj.com)
